attempts_and_resolutions.issue: First real-corpus pilot AE export failed strict reconstruction parity:21 elements,max3.22e-6; score parity passed
attempts_and_resolutions.resolution: BLAS/MLAS cancellation near zero; FP64 affine accumulation withFP32 parameters/activations/optimizer, matching ONNX casts;4096-row wide-range regression; tolerance unchanged. Fresh pilot-ready with new arithmetic contract; old pilot and source preserved

attempts_and_resolutions.issue: Dataset gate rejected train/test flow coverage because65s grace was added on top of EVE emission timestamp
attempts_and_resolutions.resolution: Preserve original timestamp, store separate available_at=max(EVE timestamp,flow.end+65); regression test; rebuild immutable dataset-ready without lowering gates

attempts_and_resolutions.issue: AppArmor tcpdump could capture in private namespace but refused Codex stop signals
attempts_and_resolutions.resolution: User added signal(receive) peer=chatgpt and reloaded only tcpdump profile; all four probes stopped

attempts_and_resolutions.issue: Initial private Nginx used unmapped nobody UID
attempts_and_resolutions.resolution: user root only inside one-user namespace mapping; failed lab stopped; fresh capture created

attempts_and_resolutions.issue: Suricata custom arbitrary X-Request-Id did not produce correlation headers
attempts_and_resolutions.resolution: Private Unix-stream sink receives response headers transiently, persists ID allowlist only; real PCAP preflight verified correlation

attempts_and_resolutions.issue: Privacy regression found hostname/redirect free text in sensor projection
attempts_and_resolutions.resolution: HTTP field allowlist drops unused text/redirects; canary regression passes

attempts_and_resolutions.issue: Full tests in a systemd service cannot create user/network namespace under unprivileged_userns AppArmor profile
attempts_and_resolutions.resolution: Capture tests executed in existing permitted Codex context with2CPU affinity; train/export cgroup service verified separately; no policy broadening

attempts_and_resolutions.issue: Launcher test assumed2 threads under an already2CPU test affinity
attempts_and_resolutions.resolution: Portable1thread policy assertion; production50% cap retained
